mathematical_basis.null_curve_fact: g and gtilde have the same unparametrized null geodesics
mathematical_basis.affine_parameter_relation: If lambda is affine for g along a null geodesic and tilde_lambda is affine for gtilde, then d(tilde_lambda)/d(lambda) is proportional to Omega^2 along the curve (up to orientation and normalization).
mathematical_basis.consequence: When Omega tends to 0 at I+, lambda -> infinity can correspond to finite tilde_lambda. Conversely, completeness of an induced generator parameter on I+ is not automatically equivalent to divergence of physical g affine length.
mathematical_basis.scope: This is a definition-level issue, not a theorem or a claim about the truth of WCC.

schema_text.current_text: every null geodesic generator of I+ is future-complete: it is defined for all values of the affine parameter induced by gtilde; equivalently every future-directed null geodesic reaching I+ has infinite affine length with respect to g

required_lead_action: Choose the metric whose affine completeness is part of the class definition.
If physical completeness is intended, define it on physical null geodesics of (M,g) and remove the asserted equivalence to gtilde-generator completeness unless a precise convention proves it.
If unphysical-generator completeness is intended, state that convention without calling it equivalent to physical affine divergence.
Supply a primary-source citation or a falsifiable conformal-parameter lemma before FROZEN rev30.
